notes.title: Sensitivity Issues
notes.notes:
Hey Guys!

Some users have been experiencing sensitivity issues (mouse not working).
If you have this problem. Go into a stage and press ESC set your sensitivity and press save. Hopefully this fixes your problem.


Best,
Raymond Leung
